events.title: Clean up failed CodexRPC initialization
events.body:
Ji An: Wrap selector registration and the initialization handshake in exception-safe cleanup. If either fails, close acquired pipes and the selector, terminate and reap the child, then re-raise the original exception. Evidence: __init__ currently lets registration, initialize, and initialized-send failures escape without cleanup. Critic pass: this establishes a missing cleanup path, not proof of observed process leaks; the revised claim is that failed construction should deterministically release acquired resources.
Add an offline regression using fake Popen, selector, and streams. Inject registration failure, initialize timeout, RPC error, and initialized-send failure. Assert all acquired resources are closed, the child is reaped, and the original exception survives cleanup errors. Simulate a termination timeout and assert kill followed by wait. Include successful initialization as a control. Falsify the claimed improvement if any injected failure leaves a resource open or changes the original exception.
Cleanup can mask the initiating error or wait indefinitely. Preserve the original exception and bound shutdown waits. Keep existing handshake capabilities and live model defaults unchanged. These tests are proposed, not executed.
